limit.description: Number of papers to return (1–10). Default: 5.

min_year.description: Only return papers published this year or later (e.g. 2020). Optional.

open_access_only.description: If true, request works with free-to-read full text. An OA URL may be a landing page, not a PDF; this is not a reuse license. Default: false.

query.description: Search query. Natural-language or keyword (e.g. 'transformer attention mechanism', 'CRISPR gene editing cancer', 'bitcoin game theory').

sort.description: Sort order. relevant = OpenAlex relevance score; cited = most-cited first; recent = newest first. Default: relevant.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Academic paper search via OpenAlex, subject to its limited keyless usage budget. Returns top papers with title, authors, year, DOI, citation count, open-access status, and primary research topic. Covers all disciplines: AI/ML, medicine, physics, economics, law, biology, and more. Supports relevance, citation-count, and publication-year sorting; open-access filtering; and minimum-year constraints. Open access describes readability, not reuse permission or guaranteed PDF availability. Use for literature review, prior-art search, citation building, or finding seminal papers. Every response includes a recommended_next pointer to research-synthesis ($0.20) for cross-source synthesis of the returned papers.

abstract.description: Up to 500 abstract characters from a bounded valid index; null for missing, malformed or over-limit data. Reuse rights are not established here.

oa_url.description: Reported free-to-read HTTP(S) link (PDF or landing page), not fetched or license-verified.

recommended_next.description: Upgrade path to research-synthesis ($0.20) for cross-source synthesis of these results.

total_in_index.description: Upstream total matching works, or null if missing/invalid; not the returned page length.
